subsection: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
question_text: Name one U.S. military conflict after the September 11, 2001 attacks.

why_it_matters.text: After 9/11, the U.S. launched the 'Global War on Terror.' The War in Afghanistan (2001-2021) targeted al-Qaeda and the Taliban government that sheltered them. It became one of America's longest wars along with Vietnam — lasting 20 years. The War in Iraq (2003-2011) overthrew Saddam Hussein but found no weapons of mass destruction. Over 7,000 U.S. troops died in the two wars combined.

fun_fact.text: On May 1, 2011 — nearly 10 years after 9/11 — Navy SEAL Team Six raided a compound in Abbottabad, Pakistan. They killed Osama bin Laden, the al-Qaeda leader who planned the 9/11 attacks. Bin Laden had been hiding in a heavily fortified compound just half a mile from Pakistan's main military academy. President Obama announced it that night.
